answer: Stamp escalation: the k-th answer of an epoch window needs a hash stamp of 12 + floor(log2(k/64)) bits, floored at 12 for k below 64. Velvet is the cheap lane, ranks 1 to 127 at 12 bits, 4096 hashes each. Voyage is each doubling band above it, adding 1 bit, so rank 1024 pays 16 bits, 65536 hashes. Oasis is the rest window: the rank counter resets every 30 minutes. Failure mode: 1000 fakes in one window cost about 21 million hashes. Check rule: the node recomputes each stamp from the beacon. Cheapest bypass: rent GPUs unless rank counts per funding tree.
